faqs.q: Can I submit my manuscript to Redhot?
faqs.a: No. We don’t accept unsolicited submissions. However, if you are an already published writer, you can apply to join our immersive Redhot workshops.

Hands-on labs where selected authors get guided through the complex research and development behind our books, from African history and wildlife sleuthing to detective plotting and cultural deep dives.
Yes. Redhot Authors sign publishing contracts and earn royalties.

faqs.q: Who owns the rights to my story?
faqs.a: Copyright is shared with Storymoja. Authors earn a standard 10% NET ROYALTY.
Children deserve more than exam prep. Our mission is to make kids LOVE books.

faqs.q: What kinds of stories do you publish?
faqs.a: High-quality African stories driven by social justice, African history, detective fiction and live storytelling.

faqs.q: What ages are your books for?
faqs.a: Redhot Novels (+15 years), Best African Series (+12 years), Shizu Historical Fiction (11–14 years), SUDEF Wildlife Detectives (9–13 years), Case Crackers (7–9 years), Redhot Picture Books (<9 years)

faqs.q: Are your books in Kiswahili too?
faqs.a: Yes, some already — with more on the way.

faqs.q: What’s the relationship between Storymoja, Start A Library, and Redhot?

faqs.a: You can: Share reviews, join the bookclub, tune into the podcast, volunteer, support campaigns.
Storymoja is committed to a safe environment for everyone. Respect is non-negotiable.
